# WHP Vending

Wheeler Hubbell Publishing, Inc. machine-facing catalog.

Catalog: /catalog/v1/index.json
Discovery: /.well-known/whp-vending.json
OpenAPI: /openapi.json
Purchase endpoint: POST /v1/purchases

Products currently configured:
- Decision Integrity Claim Classifier — USD 2.99
- Decision Integrity Return the Burden — USD 4.99
- Decision Integrity — Audit the Move — USD 7.99
- Decision Integrity Limited Verdict — USD 9.99
- Decision Integrity Response Auditor — USD 19.99

Discovery and inspection are free. Paid acquisition uses HTTP 402 with Stripe Machine Payments Protocol when LIVE runtime authority is present.
